changed: With Confirm before delete on, deleting a program now says how many dances lose it from their calling history, for example "3 dances will lose this program from their calling history". The count follows your calling-history settings. The prompt is still opt-in, and swiping a row in the programs list still deletes without it.

added: `ProgramRepository.danceCountLosingHistory` counts the distinct dances whose calling history lists a program, under the same performed-only, event-date and caller settings as `callingHistoryForDance`.
